metaData.originalTitle: 一夜之间，ChatGPT 变成了第二个 Claude
metaData.title: Overnight, ChatGPT Turned into the Second Claude
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI announced the integration of Codex into ChatGPT, along with six new role-specific plugins and features like Sites, marking a strategic shift from a general-purpose conversational interface to an enterprise workflow Agent platform, directly competing with Anthropic's Claude.
metaData.summary: This article details a series of product updates announced by OpenAI in June 2026. The core change is the integration of Codex into ChatGPT, upgrading it from a conversational interface to a unified Agent workspace. The article reveals Codex's rapid growth metrics (5 million weekly active users, 20% non-developer users) and highlights six new role-specific Codex plugins (Data Analysis, Creative Production, Sales, Product Design, Public Stock Investment, and Investment Banking), along with two new features: Sites (converting outputs into interactive websites/light apps) and annotations (precise markup and modification). The article also delves into the competitive context behind OpenAI's move: Anthropic's Claude Code has taken the lead in coding tools, prompting OpenAI to restructure its team, position Codex as the core execution layer, and leverage ChatGPT's 900 million user base to expand enterprise revenue. The article concludes that the shift from conversation to workflow Agent represents a critical watershed in the competition between OpenAI and Anthropic.

mainPoints.point: OpenAI integrates Codex into ChatGPT, pivoting product logic entirely toward an Agent platform.
mainPoints.explanation: Users no longer need to switch between ChatGPT and Codex. Codex's Agent capabilities will cover desktop, mobile, and enterprise tools like Excel and Slack, making ChatGPT a unified work interface.

mainPoints.point: Six role-specific plugins are released, taking Codex from a general-purpose tool deep into enterprise workflows.
mainPoints.explanation: Targeting roles such as data analysis, sales, and investment banking, the Codex plugins bundle relevant apps, skills, and workflows, covering 62 popular applications and 110 skills, designed to adapt to existing enterprise working methods.

mainPoints.point: Sites and annotations features change the form of AI deliverables and the way of collaboration.
mainPoints.explanation: Sites allows Codex to output interactive websites or light apps, replacing traditional documents; annotations enable users to precisely mark up and locally modify AI-generated content, improving collaboration efficiency.

mainPoints.point: The integration of Codex is a competitive response to Anthropic's Claude Code lead.
mainPoints.explanation: Claude Code's lead in coding tools prompted OpenAI to restructure its team, position Codex as the core execution layer, and leverage ChatGPT's massive user base to expand its share of the enterprise AI market.

keyQuotes: The dialog box is just the appetizer of the AI era; truly taking over workflows is Codex's ambition and the ultimate watershed for enterprise AI.
Codex's pivot also has a clear competitive backdrop.
OpenAI hopes to use the super app to bring Codex to over 900 million consumer users to scale its revenue.

relatedArticles.title: iPhone Finally Gets Siri AI! But Mainland China Misses Out on the First Release, Alarm Clock Becomes the Biggest Surprise
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: WWDC26 unveils iOS 27 and new Apple Intelligence developments, upgrading Siri to a system-level AI assistant with its own app, but users in mainland China will temporarily miss out on the AI features.

relatedArticles.title: Elon Musk weighs in! Kimi's paper challenges the 'ancestral foundation' of large models
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has released the 'Attention Residuals' technical report. By introducing attention mechanisms into deep residual connections, it challenges and reconstructs the underlying architecture that large models have relied on for a decade, significantly improving training efficiency.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Is Not the Goal, Knowledge Is the Moat — Knowledge Accumulation Practices of an AI Engineering Delivery Team
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the engineering delivery practices of an AI Team, this article proposes that knowledge accumulation is more important than workflow orchestration, and systematically introduces a complete methodology encompassing a five-layer knowledge storage architecture, a three-level maturity system, and how workflows serve knowledge accumulation.

relatedArticles.title: Investing 10,000 RMB in AI: A Year of Tools, Practices, and Reflections
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A systematic summary of a veteran developer's practical experience in the AI wave, covering everything from MAC toolchain optimization and Harness Engineering architectural constraints to building an Agent-driven automated learning loop.

relatedArticles.title: The Evolution of Agent/Skills/Teams Architectures and Principles of Technology Selection
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically reviews the evolutionary trajectory of AI Agents from monolithic to multi-agent, then to Skills pluginization and Teams parallel collaboration, and, drawing on the latest research from Google and Anthropic, provides a scientific methodology for selection.

relatedArticles.title: What You Don't Know About Claude Code: Architecture, Governance, and Engineering Practices - Tw93
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of Claude Code's six-layer architecture and engineering practices, proposing a systematic Agent development methodology from context governance and skill design to a verification loop.

relatedArticles.title: Musk Spent $10 Billion to Figure Out One Thing: Not Building a Coding Agent Is a Death Sentence
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article thoroughly argues the core point that model providers must build their own coding agent products to obtain high-quality process supervision data and drive continuous model evolution, while analyzing the data game logic behind the $10 billion partnership between SpaceX and Cursor.

relatedArticles.title: Understanding Hermes in One Article: How the New Top-Tier Agent Self-Evolves from Experience
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the core innovation of the Hermes Agent—the Skills closed-loop system—detailing its complete implementation mechanism, from experience extraction and knowledge storage to intelligent retrieval and self-improvement, along with its engineering trade-offs and security considerations.

relatedArticles.title: Dialogue with MiniMax's Zeyin: Agents Will Eventually Surpass Humans, Where Do We Go From Here?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Through an in-depth conversation with Zeyin, a MiniMax Agent R&D engineer, this article reveals the design philosophy and technical details of the Agent Team architecture, as well as the industry consensus and trend shifting from model competition to scaffolding competition in Agent engineering.

relatedArticles.title: The Most Worthwhile Productivity Upgrade This Year Might Be an Entire AI-Powered Workspace
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on real workflows, this article recommends AI tools like Gemini, Kimi, Feishu, Obsidian, Plaud, GPT-Image-2, TapNow, and Claude Code, emphasizing that the core of a workspace upgrade is optimizing the human-AI collaboration, not just piling on tools.
